description: This file defines an enum CaptureRateLimits with static methods to clamp duration and fps values within specified bounds.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps the given duration in milliseconds to be within min and max bounds, with a default value if input is nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps the given frames per second to be within min and max bounds, with a default value if input is nil.
